Cross-level combat, senses, NPC travel, CE bridge, climb animations, wall risers, research gating, PS + TO support, global click-through. W12-15 SHIPPED; §94 PUBLISHED; W18 GL/MapPreview repair FIELD-VERIFIED. W19: §99 BAND DRESSING — features, biome-parity flora, per-band rock/terrain and landmark mutators on every level, plus a 7x ground-level scatter bug fixed.

**NOTE TO SELF:** running spec, not a changelog. §0 handover; §1-19 architecture; §20 compat; §21-29 bug records; §30 SUPERSEDED by §62; §31 publishing + GIT; §32-40 records; §41-44 combat/senses/travel/CE; §51 Celestial Lighting; §52-§86 records (index unchanged); **§87 GLOBAL click-through**; **§88 CE manned weapons (QUEUED)**; **§89 stall (15 sightings)**; §90 disembark tile; §91 PERF PASS; §92 BELOW-VIEW FOG GATE; §93 w15 field reports; **§94 PLANNER (PUBLISHED user-solo)**; **§95 VISUAL-FX (§95.j UNTESTED)**; **§96 WATER (SHIPPED, ⚠ UNATTRIBUTED)**; **§97 PARKED**; **§98 W18 AUDIT + GL/MAPPREVIEW REPAIR (FIELD-VERIFIED #508)**; **§99 BAND DRESSING (w19 — Tier 1 FIELD-VERIFIED #512/#514/#515; A/A2/B1/C/D BUILT-UNTESTED)**. Keep every ⚠.

# As above, So below II (V2)

> **⚠⚠ V1 SOURCE IS NOT GONE: `D:\Rimworld\As above, So below\<yyyymmdd-hhmmss>\Source\`** (ten snapshots, newest `20260726-154207`). READ THE V1 FILE FIRST when a V2 feature has an ancestor. `read` refuses that path; `bash`/`grep`/`sed` reach it.

# 0. START HERE — WINDOW 19

**WINDOW 18 IN ONE PARAGRAPH.** Audit + optimization (§98), then GL + Map Preview compat. The entire Map Preview bridge had been dead for versions — `Resolve()` threw on its second statement. Repaired; landform chain FIELD-VERIFIED at #508. §96's water fix shipped but its A/B did not discriminate (§96.e).

**WINDOW 19 — §99 BAND DRESSING.** User report: non-surface bands devoid of chunks, features and biome-density vegetation, plus two exclusion rules (anima + ancient wreckage = ground level only). Grew into six pieces. **Tier 1 (scatterers + flora parity + exclusions) FIELD-VERIFIED across three runs.** Then the user settled a LavaField and reported the bands had generic stone — which opened **A (per-band rock), A2 (biome gravel), B1 (biome terrainPatchMakers), C (band-aware biome during terrain draw), D (Tier 2 whitelist→blocklist inversion + widened edge guard)**. All built and compiling; **NONE field-tested**.

**⚠⚠ WINDOW 19 NEXT MOVES, IN ORDER:**
1. **⚠⚠ TEST A/A2/B1/C/D.** Protocol §99.k. Best tile: an **Alpha Biomes** one — `AB_PyroclasticConflagration` exercises A (forceRockTypes obsidian+slate), A2 (`AB_VolcanicGravel`), B1 (lava/obsidian patch makers) in one map. Companions must include `sarg.alphabiomes`.
2. **⚠⚠ ODYSSEY MUST BE IN `companionMods` EXPLICITLY** — see §99.j. Three whole runs were wasted because the isolated session activated only Royalty/Ideology/Biotech and every Tier 2 result was a guaranteed zero.
3. **THE PUBLISH PASS** (§31) — carries §94 docs debt + §95 + §87.b + §96 + §98 + §99. Nothing pushed since `f2939e1`; w17-w19 in autosaves only. ⚠ §96 wording caveat (§96.e). ⚠ §99's ground-level count fix is the most user-visible line in the release.
4. **⚠ §95.j static flecks + ABWaterLab — STILL UNTESTED** (w17 carry-over).
5. **⚠ INSTRUMENTATION POLICY DECISION (ask the user)** — rules 64/5. Asked w15, w16; unanswered.
6. **⚠ THE CARVE IS THE REAL GENERATION BILL** — ledger 10. §99 adds a measured 0.76-1.84 s on top.
7. Standing queue: E3 (§95.i), §88 CE (queued five windows), §89 (ruling first), §97 parked.

**✅ SHIPPED/LIVE:** w12-15 on Workshop 3776015553 (w15 `f2939e1`); §94 published user-solo. THE WORKSPACE DLL IS A DEBUG BUILD — NORMAL (`#if DEBUG` is the off switch; DECOMPILE TO PROVE at publish, rule 17/64).

**⚠ USER WORKING RULES:** (1) NEVER source design ideas from other mods unless asked — scans COMPAT ONLY; V1 exempt. (2) Building art = USER. (3) About description = USER's copy. (4) N mockups = N choices. (5) NO NEW INSTRUMENTATION WITHOUT ASKING. (6) A user deferral is a ruling. **(7) THE USER MAY CLOSE AN INVESTIGATION ON "IT WORKS" — record the residual uncertainty and move on.**

**⚠ SHIPPED KNOWINGLY UNVERIFIED (standing):** §91.c DORMANT; §90 elevator-fallback + walled-front-tile; §85 flipped up-link approachCells; §62.N, §70; §62.M, §66c, §66e. **⚠ VERIFIED-WITH-CAVEAT:** §94.g FLIP; §96 square `_MapSize` (§96.e); §99 Tier 1 (§99.e). **⚠ BUILT-UNTESTED:** **§99 A/A2/B1/C/D**; §95.j seam fix + ABWaterLab (w17); §56p; §98's C-items. **✅ FIELD-VERIFIED:** §56q/§56n/§56m/§56r + MapPreviewCompat (#508); §99 Tier 1 sky+basement dressing, surface count fix, void flora guard, zero-yield fallback (#512/#514/#515).

**What this mod is.** Up to seven z-levels in ONE RimWorld `Map`, banded along +z. Priorities: visual clarity from above, performance, vanilla parity.

**⚠⚠ THE RULES (headline forms; unabridged pre-w17 revs):** 1 CLAMP AT SELECTION. 2 NEVER PATCH `TryRebuildDirtyRegionsAndRooms`. 3 FLOOD CELLS. 4 COUNT EMITTERS/POPULATIONS/STACKS. 5 A `Touch` TARGET IS USUALLY UNWALKABLE. 6 A VANILLA HELPER CAN BE A NO-OP. 7 THE CARVE IS NOT THE LAST WORD. 8 A REPAIR PASS MUST NOT RE-CREATE DELIBERATE REMOVALS. 9 SOME MISPLACEMENTS ARE NOT VISIBLE IN THE CELL. 10 A STRUCTURE IS NOT A CELL. 11 A CELL VERDICT CANNOT AUTHORIZE A PAWN ACTION. 12 A FOREIGN SNAPSHOT IS AN INPUT YOU CAN CORRECT. 13 NEVER COPY A GRID YOU DID NOT WATCH BEING WRITTEN. 14 ASK WHAT IS AT THE DESTINATION. 15 ASSERT ALWAYS, NARRATE ON REQUEST. 16 COUNT THE WRITE PATHS. 17 A PASSING RUN THAT DID NOT REPRODUCE THE FAILURE IS NOT A FIX + decompile the binary. 18 NEVER EXONERATE ON ONE CLEAN SAMPLE. 19 `TicksGame` RESTARTS. 20 EARLIER WORK TURNS ON EVERY READINESS GATE. 21 THE PARALLEL GRIDS DO NOT TRAVEL. 22 A DERIVED GRID HAS NO PAWN. 23 AUDIT THE WEIGHTING. 24 CLAMP THE TARGET TOO. 25 A POSTFIX ON `Update` IS TOO LATE. 26 PASS THE RENDERER'S GATE. 27 SPAWN/DESPAWN OVER FLICK. 28 A FICTION FOR ONE SUBSYSTEM IS FACT TO THE REST. 29 REPORT OUTCOMES. 30 A FELT DURATION IS A CHAIN. 31 MAKE THE GUARD SAY WHICH CLAUSE. 32 A TICK CARRIES SERVICES. 33 A FILTER THAT CAN REJECT EVERYTHING MUST SAY SO. 34 INVISIBLE = ABSENT FROM EVERY LAYER. 35 A CLONED DEF IS IN NO LOOKUPS. 36 RUN VANILLA'S PREDICATE. 37 NAME THE ENFORCEMENT POINT. 38 OWN THE DRAW — AT THE FUNNEL. 39 LAST WRITE ≠ SETTLED TARGET. 40 A TRIPWIRE BEFORE THE OBSERVER IS NOT A TRIPWIRE. 41 AN UNSET FIELD IS AN UNSHIPPED FEATURE. 42 READ-DIRECTION IS THE THING'S PROPERTY. 43 DEFER THE MOVE, NEVER THE DECISION. 44 A WHOLE OFFSET ON FRAME ONE IS A TELEPORT. 45 TRAVEL ≠ ELEVATION. 46 SCALE × ROTATION = SHEAR. 47 A CACHED CURSOR CELL IS A COORDINATE ASSUMPTION. 48 A WRITE READ BACK BY ITS CALLER IS NOT A WRITE. 49 A TEST FOR A SAYS NOTHING ABOUT B. 50 TWO OWN PATCHES CANCEL SILENTLY. 51 A FACTORY CONSUMED ITS INPUT. 52 AN OVERLAY ASKS THE CLICK'S QUESTION, READ-ONLY. 53 A PREDICATE IS CLOSED OVER ITS CALLER'S ARGS. 54 SEARCH THE CAPABILITY. 55 FALLBACK JOBS COUNT. 56 RANK-VS-FILTER FINDS THE BLIND SPOT. 57 TWO "WHICH SIDE" ANSWERS = ONE WRONG. 58 ART ≠ DEF. 59 MEASURE size FROM THE DRAWING. 60 MEASURE THE PIXELS. 61 A COLOURED GRAPHIC IS A DIFFERENT OBJECT. 62 FINISHED-ANSWER TABLES ROT. 63 MEASURE PATIENCE FROM ITS EVENT. 64 OFF-BY-DEFAULT DIAGNOSTICS DON'T EXIST. 65 THE FOURTH FAILURE IS A DEFECTIVE INPUT. 66 A DESTINATION DOESN'T CONSTRAIN ENTRY SIDE. 67 ASK WHO SENT THE NEW ORDER. 68 TWICE ON ONE DEF = THE DEF'S RULE. 69 SUSPENDING A DRIVER INHERITS ITS REQUESTS. 70 OPT-IN AT N CONSUMERS = WRONG LAYER. 71 "THE" OCCUPANT CANNOT SEE A STACK. 72 A NAMED-BUILDING DESTINATION OUTLIVES CORRECTIONS. 73 A PROBE COMPUTING ITS OWN ANSWER ISN'T READING. 74 NAME THE DENOMINATOR. 75 CROSS-BAND LENGTH PRICES NORTH AS UP. 76 VERIFY THE WINNER. 77 A REVERTED FIX MAY HAVE BEEN CORRECT ARITHMETIC ON A POISONED INPUT. 78 ONE `try` AROUND N LOOKUPS MAKES N FEATURES ONE FEATURE. 79 A HOST THAT SKIPS GENSTEPS GIVES ITS GUESTS DIFFERENT FACTS. 80 A FIX THAT CANNOT BE SWITCHED OFF AGAIN IS A FIX YOU CANNOT ATTRIBUTE.
**⚠ 81 (w19) A DIMENSION THE ENGINE NEVER READS CANNOT PROTECT YOU.** `CountFromPer10kCells` squares `map.Size.x` and never touches `Size.z`/`map.Area` — banded maps got ONE band's worth of scatter sprayed over seven.
**⚠ 82 (w19) TO INHERIT A MOD'S CONTENT, RUN ITS CODE, NOT ITS DEFS.** ReGrowth's boulders are a TRANSPILER on `GenStep_RockChunks`; Alpha Biomes patches `GrowLowRockFormationFrom` and `CanEverPlantAt`. Re-running the real genstep inherits all of it.
**⚠ 83 (w19) LIE ABOUT THE MAP AT THE THREE CELL FUNNELS, NOT AT THE CALLERS.** `Map.AllCells`, `cellsInRandomOrder.GetAll()`, `GenStep_Scatterer.TryFindScatterCell`.
**⚠ 84 (w19) TAKING OVER A JOB INHERITS ITS PRECONDITIONS, NOT ITS GUARDS.** Handing flora to vanilla dropped the `Standable` test our seeders had, and vanilla has no equivalent (§99.h).
**⚠ 85 (w19) A NAME-BASED WHITELIST CANNOT BE MOD-AWARE.** It structurally excludes every mod. Alpha Biomes ships 12 TileMutatorWorkers and not one matches a vanilla name. Default to RUN, blocklist the unsafe, and put a GUARD under it (§99.i-D).
**⚠ 86 (w19) A SUBCLASS INHERITS THE PATCH YOU PUT ON ITS BASE.** `AlphaBiomes.TileMutatorWorker_TarLakes : TileMutatorWorker_Lake`, so our surface-band `GetLakeCenter` pin applies to it — running it on another band computes an out-of-band centre and every write is refused: a SILENT NO-OP that looks like a working feature. Block by TYPE (`is`), not by name.
**⚠ 87 (w19) VERIFY THE DLC/COMPANION SET IS ACTUALLY ACTIVE BEFORE TRUSTING A NEGATIVE RESULT.** Three runs reported `0 mutator run(s)` as if it were data; Odyssey was never in `activeMods` and every cleared worker hard-gates on `ModsConfig.OdysseyActive`. READ ModsConfig.xml, don't infer from content (Mountain/Caves are CORE mutators and fooled me into thinking Odyssey was on).

# 99. BAND DRESSING — EVERY LEVEL IS A REAL LEVEL

**99.a THE REPORT.** "Upper bands (and lower) devoid of rock chunks, vegetation (too sparse for biome) and features (lakes, vents, etc) including Odyssey landmarks and Vanilla Landmarks Expanded. Steam Geysers, Helixian Gas Vents, and Boulders from Regrowth 2. Anima trees should be level bounded to the ground level, and ancient wreckage, including from mods like Vanilla Vehicles Expanded and Vehicle Framework or the vanilla Mechanitor should never spawn in lower levels." **Follow-up after #516:** "the LavaField has normal stone and not biome + mod aware. We should be respect of modded rock, biomes, and tilesets and allow them to still generate." **User rulings:** flora = vanilla's own pass, PARITY (drop the alpine rim curve); features = GENERALISE; landmarks = option B, later inverted to blocklist (D); wreckage = ground level ONLY, props + mechanitor; and "A + A2 + B1, D with edge guard and C".

**99.b DIAGNOSIS (Tier 1) — THREE CAUSES.** (1) The carve is total and runs last: all gensteps generate across the whole map, then the postfix erases every non-surface band and rebuilds it; nothing re-placed what it erased. (2) `Patch_WildPlantSpawner_ABSkipDoomedBands` suppressed the initial plant pass on doomed bands (a correct perf fix), leaving band flora at our constants only — sky `0.16 × plantDensity` thinned to ×0.30 by the alpine rim curve, cavern `0.08`. (3) **⚠⚠ The GROUND level was short too**: `CountFromPer10kCells` squares `Size.x`, never reads `Size.z`, so the map got a 126×126 count sprayed over seven bands. **Rule 81.**

**99.c MECHANISM — `ABBandScope`.** Lie to gensteps at three cell funnels (rule 83): `Map.AllCells` (prefix → band `CellRect`), `MapCellsInRandomOrder.GetAll` (postfix → band-filtered shuffle), `GenStep_Scatterer.TryFindScatterCell` (prefix → sample the band, call the instance's OWN `CanScatterAt` virtually, rule 36). Veto half lives INSIDE `Patch_GenStep_Scatterer_ABBandSeam` (rule 50). Single-slot; nested Push is a hard error; `AssertNoneOutstanding` shouts on leak. Sweep budget = 2 per `Generate` (predicate only tightens as `usedSpots` grows; 2 = normal + `useFallback`, rule 74).

**99.d TIER 1 SHIPPED.** `ABBandDressing.Dress` from the tail of `CarveInner` — after `CarveGutters`, before the basement refog, **under `CarveInProgress`** (else `ABAirSpawnGuard` walks every geyser back upstairs, as it walked 18,075 basement rocks at run #46, §57). Genstep capture is a Prefix reading `GenerateContentsIntoMap`'s ARGUMENT (not `MapGeneratorDef.genSteps`, which misses runtime injections). Eligibility = capability → shape → names: `GenStep_RockChunks` (vanilla loose rock AND ReGrowth 2's boulders via their transpiler) plus any `GenStep_Scatterer` that is not `isJunk`, not `nearPlayerStart`/`nearMapCenter`, missing the blocklist fragments. Per-band reseed. Flora = vanilla's `CheckSpawnWildPlantAt` with real density and whole-map demand, **both read OUTSIDE every scope**, **no scope armed during the flora pass**. `Patch_GenStep_ABSurfaceBandScope` confines the ORIGINAL pass to the surface band (fixes 99.b(3) + deletes wasted spawns). `ABGroundOnly` pins special trees via `GenStep_SpecialTrees.CanSpawnAt` — the predicate BOTH map-gen and `IncidentWorker_AnimaTreeSpawn` funnel through; **the incident path was covered by nothing before**.

**99.e TIER 1 VERIFICATION — #512, #514, #515.** #512 (2 up/0 down, TemperateForest/Mountainous, ReGrowth+Helixien): `8 genstep run(s), 349 thing(s), 9,619 plant(s)`; dressing 1,057 ms. User: "It feels good" (rule 7). #514 (2 up/1 down): basement dressed (`BandDressing band 0` 380 ms); **void flora guard exercised — 20,807 and 32,049 open-air cells skipped**. #515: band 3 vanilla pass placed **0**, **the zero-yield fallback fired** and `ABSkyBandGen.SeedFlora` seeded 657 plants across 4,162 plateau cells (rule 33 working in the field); band 2 got 10,765. No scope leak, no wreckage audit warning, no exception in any run.
**⚠ BENIGN LOG LINES — DO NOT RE-DIAGNOSE:** `ScatterCaveDebris found no legal cell` on sky bands (a plateau has no cave) AND on basement bands (see §99.l). `AncientJunkClusters found no legal cell` in the surface band (minSpacing 85 + `allowRoofed=false` + Buildable r5 on a Mountainous tile). **⚠ `airRejections` reads near-zero and that is EXPECTED** — vanilla's `CanScatterAt` rejects void cells on `spotMustBeStandable` before our clause is reached.

**99.f-h** (Tier 2 original design, superseded by D; flora fallback registration; **99.h THE OPEN-AIR FLORA GUARD** — rule 84: `CheckSpawnWildPlantAt` skips its fertility veto entirely when the map holds any `completelyIgnoreFertility` plant, and `PlantUtility.CanEverPlantAt` **never tests passability**. It survived only by coincidence — every vanilla ignore-fertility plant also sets `wildPlantUseDistanceToShore`, which self-rejects away from water. `DressFlora` now refuses `AB_OpenAir` by reference, deliberately NOT `!Standable` (that would refuse reeds in a band tarn). ABAirSpawnGuard cannot backstop it: it stands down for all of `CarveInProgress`.)

**99.i THE LAVAFIELD FOLLOW-UP — A, A2, B1, C, D (ALL BUILT, NONE TESTED)**
- **A — PER-BAND ROCK (`ABBandRocks.cs`).** The carve resolved rock ONCE from the tile and gave it to every band. The machinery was already mod-aware (`NaturalRockTypesIn` honours `forceRockTypes`; `RockAllowedInBiome` admits `building.biomeSpecific` rock only via the biome's `extraRockTypes`; mod rocks ride `IsNonResourceNaturalRock`) — only its SCOPE was wrong. Now re-asks vanilla's question with the BAND's biome. **⚠ Delegates outright when band biome == tile biome**, so the surface is bit-identical to vanilla rather than a re-derivation that happens to agree. Palette caches rocks+noises as a PAIR (`PickIndex` indexes noises by rock index — rule 16) and `Reset()`s per carve (BiomeDef keys are global — rule 21). `AllRocksOnMap` unions across bands for the mountain-cap renderer (rule 34).
- **A2 — BIOME GRAVEL.** Vanilla writes `biomeDef.gravelTerrain ?? TerrainDefOf.Gravel` (MapGenUtility:651); we hardcoded Gravel in `ABBandedGeneration:853`, `ABCavernGen:221`, `ABSkyBandGen:213/217/231`, `Building_ABStairs2:468`. Pyroclastic wants `AB_VolcanicGravel`. **Also fixed: `ABSkyBandGen` computed `ArableTerrainFor(map.Biome)` — the tile's answer — now the band's.**
- **B1 — BIOME TERRAIN CHARACTER (`ABBandBiomeTerrain.cs`).** What makes a lava field READ as one is `biome.terrainPatchMakers`, applied by `GenStep_Terrain` (order 210, the most expensive genstep at 1,256 ms in #516) and then erased by the carve.
